name: db-admin-generator
description: Turn a SQLite database into a working admin panel: reads the schema (tables, views, keys, foreign keys, CHECK options, required and unique columns), lets you pick tables, operations and roles (admin / editor / viewer), and generates a dependency-free Node.js server plus browser UI with sign-in, search, filters, sorting, paging and forms validated against the schema. The generated admin is then started against a temporary copy of the database and self-tested over HTTP (permissions, validation, CRUD, SQL injection). Your database is never modified. Postgres and MySQL are not supported yet.

The generated admin is then started against a temporary copy of the database and self-tested over HTTP (permissions, validation, CRUD, SQL injection). Your database is never modified. Postgres and MySQL are not supported yet.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把 SQLite 数据库变成能用的管理后台：读取表结构（表、视图、主键、外键、CHECK 选项、必填和唯一列），选择要管理的表、操作和角色（admin / editor / viewer），生成没有第三方依赖的 Node.js 服务器和网页界面，带登录、搜索、筛选、排序、分页，以及按数据库结构校验的表单。生成后会用数据库的临时副本实际启动，并通过 HTTP 自测（权限、校验、增删改查、SQL 注入）。不会修改你的数据库。暂不支持 Postgres 和 MySQL。
